name: PSY 313: Clinical Neuropsychology
note: Upper-level course on neuropsychological assessment, imaging, agnosias, aphasias, amnesia, frontal lobes and recovery of function, taught by Taryn Myers.

name: The Story of Cognitive Psychology
note: Steve Most's introductory lecture on what cognitive psychology is and how it emerged, from the PSYC1011 Memory & Cognition unit, with film and archive clips.

name: PSYC2143 Introduction to Cognition
note: A 23-lecture cognition course by Daniel Lametti covering memory, concepts and categories, language, reasoning and decision making.

name: C-STAR Lectures on Aphasia and Language Rehabilitation
note: Research talks by many speakers on aphasia, stroke recovery, neuroimaging and brain stimulation for language rehabilitation.

name: General Psychology, Fall 2020
note: Dr. Aqualus Gordon's full general psychology course, opening with a long run of lectures on personality theory, then cognition and other core topics.

name: Psychology Lectures
note: Short lectures by C. H. Harney on early psychologists, evolution, motivation and research methods, plus recorded talks on the divided brain and Pinker.

name: Psychology Flipped Classroom Lectures
note: Angela Bosak's AP Psychology video lessons, beginning with the brain and split-brain research, then sensation and perception of the eye, ear, touch and taste.

name: Neural Basis of Consciousness (2021 lectures)
note: Lecture course on the neuroscience of consciousness: phenomenology, masking, neural measurement and theories.

name: Neural Basis of Consciousness (2020, by topic)
note: The 2020 consciousness lectures cut into topic videos: binocular rivalry, signal detection, attention, integrated information and theories.

name: Functional Neuroanatomy Lectures
note: Short narrated explainers on brain anatomy by Dr. Jody Reed on a personal channel with no evident academic affiliation; typical video is about 4 minutes.

name: Dementia Researcher Salon
note: Weekly sessions for dementia researchers on lab management, careers, biomarkers and trials, with guest speakers and debates.

name: Dementia Research Seminars and Interviews
note: Research seminars, roundtables and public webinars from the UK Dementia Research Institute on Alzheimer's, biomarkers, therapies and neurodegeneration.

name: Colloquium Speaker Series
note: Six talks on healthy aging, dementia risk, caregiving and age-friendly communities from the CSULB Center for Successful Aging.

name: Buckeye Neurotrauma Lectures
note: Research seminars on traumatic brain and spinal cord injury, neuroimmune responses, stem cells and disorders of consciousness.

name: Visiting Lecture Series
note: Visiting experts on dementia, Alzheimer's diagnosis, cognitive reserve, stroke and healthy brain ageing, including Petersen, Stern and Brayne.

name: Memory
note: An NPTEL course by Prof. M. K. Asthana on models of memory, research methods and the neuropsychology of memory.

name: The Multilingual Mind Lecture Series 2021/2022
note: Research talks on bilingualism and multilingual development, dyslexia screening, heritage languages and the multilingual brain.

name: The Multilingual Mind Lecture Series 2021
note: Talks by leading researchers on bilingual development in infants and children, literacy, language disorders and bilingualism's effects on the brain.

name: Selected Topics in Psychology
note: An NPTEL lecture course on neuropsychology, fMRI in psychology, the neuroscience of addiction and behavioral addictions, and art and the brain.

name: 175.205 Brain and Behaviour
note: A course reading list of other people's TED talks, Crash Course and 2-Minute Neuroscience clips rather than the instructor's own lectures.

name: ADC505: Counseling Skills and Techniques
note: Counseling course with role-play demonstrations of intake, listening and empathic skills, CBT and psychodynamic therapy.

name: Psychotherapy and Counseling
note: Counseling and breaking-bad-news videos from an individual channel with no evident institution or course structure.

name: PSY 354: Clinical Psychology
note: Taryn Myers's clinical psychology course on humanistic, experiential, behavioral and cognitive-behavioral therapy, with case studies and guest lectures.

name: Psychiatric Interviews for Teaching
note: Six teaching demonstrations of psychiatric interviews covering somatisation, self-harm, psychosis, mania, depression and anxiety.
